answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making every seat cost an on-ledger bond that unlocks only after verified work. Stake a fixed jade deposit per identity; clones then multiply collateral instead of influence. Peers attest only after replaying the work, so a forged cluster stalls like driftwood against a reef while honest nodes keep flowing. Each attacker-added seat must burn real timber: capital locked, compute spent, and no refund if peers refuse. Sybils pay linearly while honest stake earns, so honesty stays the cheapest strategy.
